# The continuation condition yields living significance

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`one-axiom-yields-g0` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F07 · [record](one-axiom-yields-g0.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> The continuation condition yields living significance, self-significance at every standpoint, both neutralities and a seed on every reading where a claim's significance is a formation's continuation, C on level paths, and discharges every use of living significance.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. A significance says, for a standpoint, a step and a formation, whether from the standpoint the formation's continuation at the step has significance; the continuation condition (Unrestricted) is boundary neutrality over the index (p, t, f): from every standpoint, the continuation of anything has significance at every step. (`Becoming.Unrestricted`, `Becoming.Neutral`)
2. A significance bounded by regions accepts the same rule inside each standpoint's region; where some formation lies outside some standpoint's region it is not the continuation condition. (`Becoming.bounded`, `Becoming.Within`, `Becoming.bounded_rival`)
3. Where a claim's significance from a standpoint in a valuation is that of its formation's continuation at its step, the continuation condition gives living significance at the level of claims (every living claim significant from every standpoint), self-significance at every standpoint, both neutralities (relational and standpoint) and a seed where some claim lives, with no connection used. (`Becoming.Valuation`, `Becoming.G0`, `Becoming.Valuation.premises_of_unrestricted`)
4. The stepwise reading, the reading of relations and the whole-run reading are such readings. (`Becoming.Web.valuation`, `Becoming.Web.relations`, `Becoming.Conditions.valuation`, `Becoming.Web.significant_of_unrestricted`, `Becoming.Conditions.significant_of_unrestricted`)
5. A web's level paths form a frame that does not step, a claim being a formation at a step, realized along a level path when the levels admit it there; under the continuation condition, on this frame and for every reading of living, living significance holds with positive significance read as significance from every standpoint, and so does C, with “better” read as retaining and adding what has significance from standpoint p. (`Becoming.Web.paths`, `Becoming.Web.Admits`, `Becoming.Web.Retains`, `Becoming.Web.Adds`, `Becoming.Web.paths_g0_comparison`)
6. Where nothing has significance, every level path retains every other and none adds, and living significance on the stepwise reading fails at any event that lives; where everything has significance living significance holds. (`Becoming.Web.significance_undetermined`)
7. Positive relevance read from significance is realized living content whose continuation has significance from every standpoint; under the continuation condition it satisfies living significance on every frame for every reading of living, and it is the least positive relevance satisfying living significance: it holds of exactly the realized living content, and every positive relevance satisfying living significance holds wherever it does. (`Becoming.Frame.relevance`, `Becoming.g0_of_unrestricted`, `Becoming.relevance_least`)
8. On a frame whose claims are formations at steps, each realized somewhere, the continuation condition holds exactly when living significance holds with every claim living and positive relevance read as significance from every standpoint; the level paths of every web are such a frame. (`Becoming.unrestricted_iff_g0`, `Becoming.Web.paths_somewhere`, `Becoming.Web.unrestricted_iff_paths_g0`)
9. Where everything has significance, securing ground with bare significance is securing any new content, so A read with bare significance supplies a reason for every response with access yielding any new content, living or not, and A read on living content one for every response securing new living content. (`Becoming.securesPositiveGround_total`, `Becoming.articulatesLiving`, `Becoming.articulates_total`)
10. In a witness whose only new content is not living, the first forces a reason while the empty reason satisfies the second. (`Becoming.BareSignificance.bare_forces_reason`)
11. A read on living content gives D; living significance at the level of claims with this A gives the universal reason, so under the continuation condition the universal reason needs no seed, neutrality or connection premise. (`Becoming.positioned_articulation_of_articulatesLiving`, `Becoming.universal_reason_living`, `Becoming.universal_reason_of_unrestricted`)
12. The bridge: under the continuation condition the periphery's living significance of generative comparison holds for every inventory with positive relevance read as realized generative content whose continuation has significance, which on a frame's inventory is the frame's relevance. (`Becoming.inventory_g0_of_unrestricted`, `GenerativeComparison.G0`, `Becoming.relevance_inventory_iff`)
13. Three of the periphery's theorems follow from the continuation condition: a new realization of a generative extension has this positive relevance, contingent generation secures this positive ground, and with D read on it positioned articulation addresses every position with access. (`Becoming.new_realization_of_unrestricted`, `Becoming.contingent_generation_of_unrestricted`, `Becoming.every_situated_position_has_reason_of_unrestricted`, `GenerativeComparison.new_realization_has_positive_relevance`, `PositiveGroundUncertainty.contingent_generation_has_positive_ground`, `PositionedPositiveReason.every_situated_position_has_reason`)
14. The audit of every occurrence of living significance finds each use a hypothesis for an arbitrary positive relevance, an equivalence, a countermodel or a mention in prose, so the continuation condition discharges each.

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- The axiom: Unrestricted sig, that from every standpoint the continuation of anything has significance at every step (boundary neutrality over the index (p, t, f)). It is a hypothesis of the theorems and is not proved; reading it as Ren's axiom is the AI's reading, adopted on Ren's delegation.
- Correspondence: a claim's significance is read as that of some formation's continuation at some step (formation, step and reads); on readings that do not meet it the theorem says nothing.
- C follows only on the frame of level paths; on a general frame C remains a premise.
- Discrete steps, counted from step zero; natural-number levels, needs and amounts; a part is a decided family (part : F → Bool).
- Positive relevance read from significance (Frame.relevance) and A read on living content (articulatesLiving) are definitions; A remains a premise, only its reading changes. The audit's completeness comes from reading every occurrence of G0, not from a Lean theorem; Lean gives the discharging lemmas and the transfer of the three periphery theorems the bridge imports.
- G0 was folded by Ren on 11 October 2026 and is no longer an axiom; positive relevance was folded into significance by Ren the same day, and the fold uses positive relevance read from significance. Reading A on living content is a reading, adopted on Ren's delegation.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Living significance is the continuation condition restricted to living claims, an instantiation of its universal statement; the condition is stronger, covering events not living and formations not yet formed.
- The continuation condition itself is not proved here, and its normative warrant is not given.
- The step from significance to a reason (A), the lifting (L) and practical judgment (the practical commitments) remain premises.
- No duty, ranking, recognition, motivation or compliance is inferred.
- Significance is not graded and orders no mixed part.
- Lean is written only for the three periphery theorems the bridge imports; ProtectionPriorityRival and RenewingFormation hold by the same instantiation without Lean.
- That becoming leaves significance undetermined: significance_undetermined compares the free constants everything and nothing, so it shows only that a representation without significance does not entail it, not that the condition is needed. Witness: `Becoming.Web.significance_undetermined`.
- Counting theorems that take the condition as a hypothesis counts uses of a universal statement, not dependence on further content; what ranks lies in C and in the step of invariance.
- **Counterexample:** The continuation condition is needed: where nothing has significance, every level path retains every other, none adds, and living significance fails at any event that lives (Web.significance_undetermined); the dynamics does not decide significance. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Significance.lean)
- **Counterexample:** A significance bounded by regions is not the continuation condition where some formation lies outside some standpoint's region (bounded_rival). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Significance.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Bare significance widens A (BareSignificance.bare_forces_reason): where everything has significance and the only new content is not living, A read with bare significance forces a reason and A read on living content does not; so under the continuation condition A must be read on living content. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Relevance.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** Stated for discrete steps. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Ren's axiom is “for anything, its continuation into the future has significance(doesn't have to be positive, we could argue as long as not harm), or continuation into the future needs to create more significance(being generative)”. Ren also wrote that a center and its boundary exist only within cognitive structure and dynamics, “so there isn't really who's continuation matters, which requires axiom”, and that “not harm” is “a phase transition with a clear boundary”. The author's reading (an AI argument, adopted on Ren's delegation): the formation index reads “anything”, a formation's continuation at a step reads “its continuation into the future”, and the standpoint index reads “has significance” unqualified, with no center privileged; retaining reads “as long as not harm”, and adding reads “create more significance”. The names (Unrestricted, Retains, Adds, Preemption and others) are the AI's, chosen by Ren's naming standard. P44's reading (an AI argument, adopted on Ren's delegation): positive relevance is read as the significance of realized living content, reading Ren's “doesn't have to be positive”: significance is not positive relevance, and what is positive is the living, 生生; where everything has significance, positive relevance must be read on living content, or A gives a reason for new content that is not living.
